# A kill or recipient removal by an admin whom our side removed since the base
# still stands: the merging admin re-signs it. Dropping it would bring the
# killed user or key back - on develop too, once the branch is squashed into it.

sesam-repo admin base.txt

cp $TMPDIR/base.txt s
exec sesam add s --group admin
exec sesam tell --user bob --recipient $BOB_PUBKEY --group admin
exec sesam tell --user carol --recipient $CAROL_PUBKEY --group dev
exec sesam tell --user dave --recipient age1tdy2pxsfwpxxe0c9cuwty8zpsv6uuhf4zyug5f9lfl982lh3tctqrw2ll7 --group dev
exec sesam user add-recipient --user dave --recipient 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGton+aQGCo+e3c/DPpR6qXCZwBNlh15Aqwua74O/SFA'
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'base: bob admin, carol and dave dev'
exec git branch develop

# develop: bob kills carol and removes dave's second key.
exec git checkout develop
env SESAM_ID=$BOB_KEY
exec sesam kill --user carol
exec sesam user remove-recipient --user dave --recipient 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGton+aQGCo+e3c/DPpR6qXCZwBNlh15Aqwua74O/SFA'
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'develop: bob kills carol, removes a key of dave'

# feature: admin kills bob, then merges develop.
env SESAM_ID=$ADMIN_KEY
exec git checkout -b feature HEAD~1
grep AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGton sesam.yml
exec sesam kill --user bob
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'feature: kill bob'

! exec git merge --no-edit develop
stderr 'author bob was revoked on our side, but the removal stands'
exec git commit --no-edit
exec sesam user ls
! stdout carol
! grep AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGton sesam.yml

# Squashed into develop, carol and the key stay gone.
exec git checkout develop
exec git merge --squash feature
exec git commit --no-verify -m 'squash feature'
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'
exec sesam user ls
! stdout carol
! stdout bob
! grep AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGton sesam.yml

-- base.txt --
S=BASE
